comparisonVerdict.reason: Child SIGKILLed at the worker's 180000ms timeout during teardown, after the mount had already failed. The eight-trial plan never completed; one of four authorized fixtures was created.

reproduced.claim: The startup failure reproduced on the FIRST fresh trial through the original harness executable.

localization.note: The pinned preview view request (GET /api/vflow/projects/<id>/editor/previews/<buildHash>/view) had already returned 200. The iframe's blocking runtime script never received a response, so its load event never fired, which is exactly what timelinePhase 'load-pending' reports.
localization.mechanism: loadRuntimeSourceForDev (vite.config.ts:11-24) calls server.ssrLoadModule() on EVERY request with no caching or single-flight guard. The first, cold SSR transform of packages/core/src/inline-scripts/hyperframe.ts competes with the ~900 concurrent client-module transforms the cold dev server is performing for the app shell.
localization.mechanismStatus: NOT PROVEN. Consistent with every measurement below, but the starvation/deadlock internals were not instrumented.

rulesOut.fixtureFreshness: Test A ran a COLD-restarted server against the REUSED fixture video-092ff8c1-ff82-4a90-8c73-dc6dd0dc2ff1: mount passed in 1957ms, timelinePhase 'ready', 3 clips, observedReady true. Fixture freshness is not the variable.
rulesOut.priorCorrection: The earlier claim that fixture reuse was the leading remaining difference was wrong on its own terms: managed-startup-trial.mjs:145 also performs a /api/vflow/projects/<id>/editor GET before its page.goto at :200, which managed-studio.mjs does not. Two constants differed, not one.
